sourceFindings.finding: digest opens raw FileIO with buffering0 and owns one1MiB bytearray through a memoryview context. It checks actual bytearray.__alloc__ against view length+1 before any read, rejects invalid count types/ranges, hashes only the returned count and loops through valid short reads to EOF. Nested views are released each iteration; both the fixed view and raw file close on normal or exceptional exit. No repeated returned-bytes block is introduced by this Python read loop.

Origin retains the existing configured chunk size and request/counter boundaries while reading into one fixed backing. Each target subview limits the final request remainder and each returned-count subview limits write/hash input; short reads reduce remaining by actual count. Invalid/zero premature counts remain transport failures. Actual read count/bytes, proportional slow delay and final flushed-block truncation digest remain tied to bytes actually handled. The outer backing/file scopes end before truncation hold, activity decrement and terminal log. The recorded sourceBackingCapacityBytes is bytearray ob_alloc, not process RSS or a claim about every native allocator.

The fixed bytearray is fresh, has no external production alias and remains exported through the backing memoryview for its entire read loop. The one pre-use capacity check therefore applies to this unchanged backing across reads. The excess-retained-capacity regression checks a real minor-downsized bytearray, rather than substituting its logical len for backing capacity.

Five methods cover real empty/short/over1MiB files and exact hashes, one backing, repeated synthetic short reads, propagated OSError with close/release, actual retained excess capacity rejection before read, and Origin19bytes delivered as7short reads with one8byte backing/capacity9 and close-before-terminal behavior.

The prior lifetime and concurrency fixtures now provide readinto and track actual backing weak references. Prior assertion ASTs in both edited existing test modules are exact; eleven lifetime and four concurrency methods remain. No freezing contract, threshold, sample, chunk configuration or concurrency limit changed.

bytearray.fact: Resize can retain ob_alloc on a minor downsize; actual allocated character backing must not be inferred from logical length alone.

fileio.fact: FileIO.readinto passes caller buffer pointer/length to _Py_read and returns its count; EAGAIN may returnNone, which this regular-file path rejects as an invalid count.
